apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Faster and lighter on the cloud: each phone and computer now downloads only what changed since it was last open, instead of the whole shop every time. New: Refresh Everything (desktop: Settings → Phones & Cloud; phone: Settings → Shop) downloads it all again if anything ever looks out of date.
